label: For "Clinical Communication Delay & Escalation Risk Prediction": Predict which messages are likely to miss acknowledgement or response service levels or stay unresolved, and give the escalation owner a time-to-response estimate and a trigger, while urgent deterministic escalation always overrides the model. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Letting the score replace urgent timers.
